content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working on a school robot project and facing an issue. I need to set up a push button switch in [product_name] Web Editor. In the program, the switches are set as momentary, but the robot keeps moving even after the button is no longer pressed, behaving like a standard switch instead of a momentary one. Any assistance would be greatly appreciated. Kind regards, [user_name]
Are you using the latest version of [product_name] Web Editor, specifically [version_no]?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing difficulty configuring a push button in [product_name] Web Editor to function as a true momentary switch for a robot project. The current setup causes the robot to continue operating after the button is released, indicating a mismatch between the desired and actual behaviors. This points to possible limitations in the web editor's features or user guidance around configuring button states.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the push button in the web editor to operate as a momentary switch—activating the robot only while pressed and stopping immediately upon release.
